packageRules.description: Test-only infrastructure ships nothing to production, so a bad version can only turn the required 'Build and Test (.NET)' check red, which already blocks the merge. That makes these self-policing, so all update types automerge including majors. Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing and EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory are deliberately NOT listed: although test-only, they belong to the 'dotnet monorepo' group that bumps the whole .NET runtime in lockstep, and matching one member would leak automerge onto that framework-wide PR.
Build-time only: analyzers, polyfill source generators, SourceLink and reproducible-build SDKs emit nothing at runtime, so a bad version fails the build rather than reaching production.
Front-end tooling that never reaches the shipped bundle: Prettier only formats source, so a bad version cannot change runtime behaviour.

tslib supplies the TypeScript emit helpers. Both TypeScript (~6.0.2) and @angular/core (22.x) depend on it with a wide '^2.3.0' range, so a 2.x bump cannot break that contract, and any incompatibility would be a compile error in the required 'Build and Test (Angular)' check. Majors are excluded because a tslib 3.x would be exactly the case where those ranges stop being satisfied.

Test-only front-end tooling: jsdom provides the test DOM and vitest runs the suite, so a bad version only turns the required 'Build and Test (Angular)' check red. Majors stay manual because jsdom majors drop Node versions and the vitest v5 major was rejected by hand in #38.
